藏品名称_EN: Unity of the People of All National Races
描述_EN: the the top centre, against a red sky, is the emblem of the peoples' republic of china surrounded by doves. there is a yellow macramé fringe at each end. wall carpet, knotted pile of coloured silks and flat metallic thread worked in the weft-wrapping weave known as pinjin in chinese or soumak in the west. the corners show, from top left clockwise, a bucket of molten steel, a wheatsheaf, cotton bolls and a truck of coal. the pictorial design is one commensurate with the movement known as the great leap forward. below this, dancing on a green sward and encircled by a garland of flowers, grapes and peaches, are representatives of the national minority peoples of china. a soldier from the peoples' liberation army plays the accordion.
描述_ZN: 顶部中心，在红色的天空下，是中国人民共和国的标志，周围有鸽子。 两端有一个黄色的macramé流苏。 墙毯，由彩色丝绸和扁平金属线组成的结堆，在中国称为pinjin或西方称为soumak的纬线包裹编织。 四角显示，从左上角顺时针方向，一桶熔化的钢，一个麦穗，棉花棒和一车煤。 图画设计是与被称为大跃进的运动相称的。 下面是中国少数民族的代表，他们在绿色的草地上跳舞，被鲜花、葡萄和桃子的花环所包围。 一位人民解放军战士在拉手风琴。
